display_name: Cut over to a reconciliation-approved release
description: Local self-deployment cutover authorized by an approved reconciliation: compare-and-swap on current release, router-active instance and start token, manifest ETag, and both surface digests, then the target-owned blue-green swap. All refusals precede any spawn, and the reconciliation identity is recorded in the candidate release VERSION.
embedding_description: Activate a new immutable local release for bytes an approved reconciliation already wrote, on a target that exposes this interface. Use for idempotent cutover re-runs or a cutover-only plan; stale approval values refuse before anything is built.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Cutover status, prior release and exact prior instance, and the provenance recorded in the candidate.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status and reason_code, and keep the prior instance id visible because rollback selects that exact instance. A queued cutover is not a verified one; say so rather than implying the new bytes are serving.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: The cutover could not be proven safe. Treat it as an unproven outcome, not as a rollback and not as a success.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Re-observe release, instance, start token and ETag, obtain a fresh approval, and retry. An unreadable verification is never a reason to roll back.
